events.title: GriefShare - Grief Support Group
events.description:
The loss of a loved one turns your world upside down.
GriefShare support groups help you find the path toward stability, healing, and hope.

Please join us: Weekly starting at 5:00 PM, Tuesday, December 8th.
Register here: https://find.griefshare.org/groups/307059
Feel free to contact Pastor Jeremiah at jeremiahw@cowboychurch.org, or visit griefshare.org, if you have questions or would like more information.

events.title: Sunday Message: A Brand New Start
events.description:
A BRAND-NEW START: Is God Saying Go ... Or Not Yet?
A new job? A big move? An unexpected opportunity? We all face moments when we're ready for something different. But what if the biggest challenge isn't deciding WHERE to go, but knowing WHEN to go? What if we're overlooking something important?
This Sunday, October 25, we'll discover some fascinating lessons from Noah's remarkable new beginning. You might be surprised by what his story reveals about the decisions we face, the opportunities ahead, and what really makes a BRAND-NEW START successful!
Join us at 10:00 a.m. at Cowboy Church, Hwy 65 and Crosstown Blvd. in Ham Lake. Come as you are—and bring a friend. You belong here!
